```yaml
name: PR Review and Issue Triage

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited]
  issues:
    types: [opened]

jobs:
  review_pr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install claudie
      
      - name: Run PR review command
        run: claudie /review-pr ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
    
  review_issue:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install claudie
      
      - name: Run issue review command
        run: claudie /review-issue ${{ github.event.issue.number }}

  create_issue_templates:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Create issue templates
        run: |
          mkdir .github
          echo "---
          name: Bug report
          about: Create a report to help us improve
          title: ''
          labels: bug
          body:
            - **Describe the bug**
              - A clear and concise description of what the bug is.
            - **To Reproduce**
              - Steps to reproduce the behavior.
            - **Expected behavior**
              - A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
            - **Environment (please complete the following information):**
              - OS: [e.g. iOS]
              - Browser [e.g. chrome, safari]
              - Version [e.g. 22]
          ---" > .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml
          
          echo "---
          name: Cookbook Proposal
          about: Suggest a new cookbook or improvement to an existing one
          title: ''
          labels: proposal
          body:
            - **Preflight Checklist**
              - [ ] I have read the [contributing guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md)
              - [ ] My proposal aligns with the project's goals
            - **Problem Statement**
              - What problem does your proposal solve?
            - **Learning Objectives**
              - What will users learn from implementing this proposal?
            - **Outline**
              - A brief outline of the proposal
          ---" > .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/cookbook_proposal.yml
          
          echo "---
          name: Question
          about: Ask a question about the project
          title: ''
          labels: question
          body:
            - **Question**
              - What would you like to know?
            - **Links**
              - Any relevant documentation or resources
          ---" > .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/question.yml
          
          echo "---
          name: Config
          about: Enable blank issues or link to additional resources
          title: ''
          labels: config
          body:
            - **Enable Blank Issue**
              - [ ] Yes
            - **Link to Resources**
              - [Discord](https://discord.gg/claudefed)
              - [Docs](https://docs.claudefed.com)
              - [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)
          ---" > .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml
```
